# Test stories

Freely distributable stories used by the automated tests and the screenshots in CI
(taken from the test suite of [emglken](https://github.com/curiousdannii/emglken)):

- `advent.z5`, `advent.ulx` – *Adventure* by Will Crowther and Don Woods, Inform port by Graham Nelson.

Other formats are tested locally with story files in `test/stories/` (not committed).
